defs.def: having too much flesh on it and weighing too much 人或动物的身体

ex.s: “You don’t want to get fat” was on constant repeat throughout my childhood.
ex.t: “你不想变胖”这句话在我整个童年里被不断重复。

ex.s: But one day when I heard her saying “I think I’m too fat,” my heart sank.
ex.t: 但有一天，当我听到她说“我觉得自己太胖了”时，我的心一沉。

ex.s: But in half the cases she wore a specially designed fat suit which increased her weight to 180 pounds.
ex.t: 但在一半的情境下，她穿了一件特制的肥胖装，使体重增至180磅。

defs.def: thick or wide 厚的；宽大的

ex.s: Then I read an article that said instead of asking “Am I fat?” I should be asking “Am I fit?” I had no idea a letter could make such a difference!
ex.t: 后来我读到一篇文章，说我不应该问“我胖吗？”，而应该问“我健康吗？”我没想到一个字母的改变竟能带来这么大的不同！

defs.def: large in quantity; worth a lot of money 大量的；值钱的

ex.s: Both the fat and thin versions of the actor took a large amount of food.
ex.t: 无论穿肥胖装还是苗条装的演员都拿了大量食物。

defs.def: a white or yellow substance in the bodies of animals and humans, stored under the skin 脂肪；肥肉

ex.s: Then, on two separate morning visits to the scientists’ lab, each man walked for an hour at an average speed that, in theory should allow his body to rely mainly on fat for fuel.
ex.t: 随后，在两次分别前往科学家实验室的早晨探访中，每名男子都以平均速度走了一小时，这个速度理论上应能让身体主要依靠脂肪供能。

ex.s: Tracking of 150 biochemicals in food has been important in revealing the relationships between calories, sugar, fat and the occurrence of common diseases.
ex.t: 对食物中150种生化物质的追踪在揭示卡路里、糖、脂肪与常见疾病发生之间的关系方面发挥了重要作用。

ex.s: Just before and an hour after each workout, the scientists took additional samples of the men’s blood and fat tissue.
ex.t: 在每次锻炼前和锻炼后一小时，科学家又采集了这些男子的血液和脂肪组织样本。

ex.s: But it was the effects deep within the fat cells that may have been the most significant, the researchers found.
ex.t: 但研究人员发现，脂肪细胞深处的影响可能是最显著的。

ex.s: They burned more fat on average.
ex.t: 他们平均燃烧了更多的脂肪。

ex.s: There has been a recent trend in the food service industry toward lower fat content and less salt.
ex.t: 近来食品服务业出现了降低脂肪含量和减少盐用量的趋势。

ex.s: Most animals survive thanks to their fat, which protects them from the cold.
ex.t: 大多数动物靠脂肪生存，脂肪可以保护它们抵御严寒。

ex.s: All that fat has become muscle now.
ex.t: 所有的脂肪现在都变成了肌肉。

ex.s: I tried nofat, low-fat, 5:2, only bananas, no bananas—I almost went bananas, too.
ex.t: 我试过零脂肪、低脂肪、5:2 饮食法、只吃香蕉、不吃香蕉——我差点也疯了。

defs.def: a solid or liquid substance from animals or plants, treated so that it becomes pure for use in cooking （烹调用的）动植物油
animal and vegetable fats, when you are thinking of them as part of what a person eats （人体摄入的动植物）脂肪

ex.s: As a result, they burned more fat during walks on an empty stomach than when they had eaten first.
ex.t: 结果，他们空腹走路时燃烧的脂肪多于先吃饭时。

ex.s: Fat and salt are very important parts of a diet.
ex.t: 脂肪和盐是饮食中非常重要的组成部分。

ex.s: When fat and salt     64     (remove) from food, the food tastes as if is missing something.
ex.t: 当脂肪和盐从食物中   64   （去除），食物尝起来像少了什么。

ex.s: 67   (be) full of fat and salt; by   68   (eat) more fast food people will get more salt and fat than they need in their diet.
ex.t: 67   （充满）脂肪和盐；通过   68   （吃）更多快餐，人们会摄入超过饮食所需的盐和脂肪。

ex.s: When combined with berries or slices of other fruits, frozen bananas make an excellent base for thick, cooling fruit shakes and low fat “ice cream”.
ex.t: 当与浆果或其他水果切片结合时，冰冻的香蕉为厚、冷却的水果摇摆和低脂“冰淇淋”提供了极佳的基础。
